picker.refreshHint: List the repositories again from the provider instead of using the saved list.

status.searchToNarrow: Search or pick an owner to narrow the list.
status.stale: Saved list, refreshing in the background.
status.truncated: This account has more than the {{cap}} repositories listed here. Search only covers the first {{cap}}; paste a repository URL to use one beyond that.
status.rateLimited: The provider is rate limiting this control plane, so this is the saved list. Checking again after {{time}}.
status.rateLimitedEmpty: The provider is rate limiting this control plane and there is no saved list yet. Try again after {{time}}.
status.rateLimitedNoTime: The provider is rate limiting this control plane. Try again in a minute.

needs_reauthorize.title: {{provider}} needs to be reconnected
needs_reauthorize.body: The authorization was revoked, expired or is no longer accepted, so repositories cannot be listed or cloned until you reconnect.

revoked.title: The {{provider}} connection was removed
revoked.body: The installation or authorization no longer exists on the provider. Reconnect to use it again.

rate_limited.title: {{provider}} is rate limiting this control plane
rate_limited.body: Saved lists are still shown. It will be checked again after {{time}}.

urlWarning.private_address: This control plane's webhook address is private or local, so GitHub, GitLab and other git hosts cannot call it. Pushes will not arrive.
urlWarning.no_public_url: This control plane has no public address yet, so git hosts have no webhook address to call. Pushes will not arrive.

reliability.urlFixHint: Set a public URL for webhooks below, then register the webhook again.

registration.failed: The webhook was not registered on the provider: {{error}}

poll.disabled: Polling for missed pushes is off.

connection.needs_reconnect: The account this repository was picked from was disconnected. The source stays, but webhooks and previews cannot use it until you connect an account on the same host again.
connection.needs_reauthorize: The account {{label}} needs to be reconnected before this source's webhooks and previews work.
connection.revoked: The account {{label}} was removed on the provider. Reconnect it to use this source again.
